All three functions are now implemented and exported:

1. **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js — converts byte counts to human-readable format (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
2. **slugify(title)** in src/text.js — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, removes non-alphanumeric characters except dashes
3. **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in src/api.js — fetches users from `${baseUrl}/api/users`, logs the count using the logger, and returns the array
